text:
andrew: deploy-bot flagged a divergent chart checksum for `payments/checkout` in prod-eu, prod-us, and prod-apac. auto-rollback scheduled in 12m if not exempted. can someone confirm scope? :eyes:
maria: which digest/checksum is diverging? staging looks fine for me.
deploy-bot: automated alert: 
```
Alert: chart_checksum_mismatch
service: payments/checkout
expected: sha256:abcd1234...ef
observed: sha256:abce9999...12
regions: [prod-eu, prod-us, prod-apac]
action: rollback scheduled in 720s
reason: registry promoted image digest differs from chart values.image.digest
```

sre-oncall: thanks. quick check — this can happen if image promotion lagged and chart pushes happened after. do we have a single-way rollback or can we pin the chart to old digest short-term?
kevin: looks like artifact promotion to our prod registry lagged by 3m. image manifest in eu mirror still points to older digest. not a full outage but risk of partial traffic hitting mismatched image versions.
andrew: if it's just promotion skew we can request deploy-bot to hold for 15m while we reconcile mirrors. is there a quick exempt command?
deploy-bot: operators can add the annotation `release.redwood/hold-rollback: "true"` to the HelmRelease or run `/deploy hold <release> 15m` in this channel. note: exempt requires release-manager approval.
maria: i can push the mirror sync job now (started). will take ~4m. once mirrored, we can re-run `helm promote` or let deploy-bot reconcile.
release-manager: @maria go ahead. i'll approve a 20m hold once you confirm mirror done. annotate after sync.
kevin: mirroring started. copying command for ops runbook: `./scripts/sync-registry --image payments/checkout --from=staging --to=prod-eu,prod-us,prod-apac`
andrew: mirror job finished. verified manifests in prod-eu show `sha256:abcd1234...ef` now.
maria: applying annotation to the HelmRelease in prod namespaces:
```
kubectl annotate helmrelease payments-checkout release.redwood/hold-rollback="true" --overwrite -n payments-prod
```
andrew: annotation applied. requesting deploy-bot hold. /deploy hold payments-checkout 20m
deploy-bot: hold acknowledged by release-manager. rollback canceled. will re-check checksums in 15m and auto-clear hold if stable. :white_check_mark:
release-manager: please add a short note in the release notes: "temporary rollback hold due to cross-region image promotion lag; mirrors reconciled, hold released after verification". also add to postmortem if we see repeats.
sre-oncall: logging for visibility: created incident tracker redwood/ops-4897 with timeline.
kevin: suggest we add a pre-promotion registry checksum validation step to the release pipeline to prevent auto-rollback storms. cc: ci/cd infra.
andrew: agreed — can someone open a ticket? i'll add it to next sprint if no objections.
release-manager: thanks everyone. marking this thread resolved after hold expires. :thumbsup:
